JD for the Current running requirement of LLM / GenAI Consultant for Role for FCS Software Solutions.




Position: LLM / GenAI Consultant

Working Hours: UK Hours (1 PM to 9 PM IST)

Location - Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana (India)

Work Mode - Hybrid

Core Requirement LLM / GenAI Expertise (High Priority)

Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications/agents using platforms like OpenAI / Azure OpenAI
Strong capability in prompt engineering and structured reasoning design for analytical use cases
Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel or similar) and tool/function calling
Practical exposure to RAG architectures, including embeddings and vector stores
Ability to integrate LLMs with structured data sources (SQL/warehouses)and enable insight generation from tabular/time-series data
Understanding of LLM evaluation and guardrails (output quality, hallucination control, reliability)

Required Skills & Capabilities

Strong proficiency in Python and data processing libraries (Pandas, NumPy)
Experience with data analysis, statistical modeling, and time-series analysis
Hands-on experience with machine learning techniques (forecasting, anomaly detection) and
Experience in building recommendation or decision-support systems
Ability to translate data into actionable insights and recommendations

Engagement Expectations

Ability to collaborate with stakeholders and build scalable solutions
Strong communication and structured problem-solving skills
Work alongside our team and bring them along in building this solution by providing thought leadership and hands on training
